newsitem.title: USA: Inflation targets have benefits--US Congress panel.
newsitem.headline: Inflation targets have benefits--US Congress panel.

text.p: A study by the Congressional Joint Economic Committee found that inflation-targetting by central banks has economic benefits and set out parameters for implementing such a strategy in the United States.

"Preliminary evidence suggests the inflation targetting experience of many foreign central banks has been quite successful and promises to provide excellent results," the study, released on Friday, said.
It argued that inflation targets promote economic and financial stability and lead to lower interest rates and sustainable economic growth.
